request.summary: Create a responsive operations KPI board with summary metrics, target progress, and a trend chart.
request.audience: Operations teams monitoring fulfillment performance on shared displays.
request.primaryGoal: Make current performance and exceptions immediately legible while retaining recent trend context.

assumptions: Metrics and history remain separate collections because flattening them would lose their relationship.
The dashboard renders at most three primary metrics and twenty-four trend points.

surfaceStrategy.rationale: The same operational story must remain useful in dashboard bands, standard displays, portrait screens, and compact tiles.

surfaces.purpose: Wide dashboard band with compressed secondary detail.

settings.purpose: Selects the coordinated Dark, Light, or Custom color scheme.

dynamicText.fallback: At the readable minimum, keep one line and ellipsize the remaining tail.
dynamicText.rationale: The configurable title is the board anchor and must fit before the timestamp and KPI field are compressed.

dynamicText.fallback: Clamp after two lines so the value and delta remain visible.
dynamicText.rationale: Metric labels may need a second line, but numeric values and trend context retain priority.

states.expectation: The coordinated light preset preserves KPI hierarchy and semantic status contrast.
An explicit empty state occupies the dashboard without layout collapse.
Long metric labels and deltas remain readable in a wide-low surface.
Updated metrics replace current values without rebuilding the app.

behaviors.expectation: The trend remains bounded, paints real data, and preserves balanced KPI card geometry.
Datasource updates propagate to metric labels and values.
An empty datasource still identifies the app and states why the surface is empty, in text legible at the declared viewing distance.

visualDirection.summary: A restrained analytical composition that makes the current operational exception dominant and the trend explanatory.
signatureChoices: One oversized primary KPI anchors the reading order.
The trend is an integrated evidence field rather than a decorative chart card.
avoid: A uniform grid of equally weighted metric cards.

visualReview.intent: A quiet operational dashboard with one dominant metric story, restrained surfaces, and a readable trend.
focus: Verify the chart never crowds or overlaps metric cards at narrow and tall sizes.
Verify numeric values remain dominant while long supporting text truncates or wraps intentionally.
